prompt:
What do I need to know from this school newsletter?

Maple Grove Elementary — Family Newsletter
Friday, October 9, 2026

Hello families,

Picture day is next Wednesday for all grades. Order forms are due the same morning; packages start at $18.

Grade 3 will visit the Riverside Science Center on Thursday, October 22. Permission slips and the $6 bus fee are due by Monday, October 19.

Grade 5 families: band instrument rental night is Tuesday at 6 p.m. in the gym.

The book fair planned for October 13 has been cancelled. We will share a new date soon.

Starting next week, Grade 3 library day moves from Tuesday to Thursday. Please send library books back on Thursdays.

Reminder: there is no school on Monday, October 12 (staff training day).

Our fall food drive runs all next week. Canned goods can go in the bins by the front office.

The PTA meets on Tuesday, October 13 at 7 p.m. in the library. All families are welcome.

Thank you,
Ms. Alvarez, Principal

Summarize the important stuff in this newsletter for my 3rd grader.

Maple Grove Elementary — Family Newsletter
Friday, October 16, 2026

Hello families,

Our Halloween parade is Friday, October 30 at 9 a.m. on the blacktop. Costumes are optional; please no masks or toy weapons.

Grade 3 field trip reminder: we leave for the Riverside Science Center next Thursday. If you have not returned the permission slip and $6 bus fee, please send them in by Monday.

Parent-teacher conference sign-ups open on Monday. Conferences are on November 5 and 6, with early dismissal at 12:30 p.m. both days.

Correction: picture retake day is November 4, not November 3 as printed in the school calendar.

Grade 4 and 5 students: science fair entry forms are due October 23.

Good news: the book fair is back on. It will run October 26 to 29 in the library.

Lost and found will be donated on Friday, October 23. Please check it for missing jackets and water bottles.

Thank you,
Ms. Alvarez, Principal

Here is this week's school newsletter. My child is in Grade 3.
Make one table with these columns: Date | What | Bring or pay | Deadline.
- Write every date as a calendar date with the weekday (for example, Mon Jan 5). If the newsletter gives only a weekday or "next week", work out the date from the newsletter's date.
- Include only things for Grade 3 or for all grades.
- Leave out anything cancelled.
- Write "not stated" if something is missing.
After the table, add a short list called "Changes" for anything moved, corrected or cancelled.
